title: Story premise EDU101: The Exit Plan Meets a Blocked Line
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (public safety/preparedness). Hook: Who checked that this arrow leads somewhere usable? Takeaway/theme: Preparedness diagrams need verified, locally appropriate routes and accessibility considerations.
description: A community center wants a preparedness illustration, but a single unverified arrow crosses a blocked doorway in its fictional floor plan. A qualified review replaces guesswork with an approved, accessible route plan.
